expectations.text: Output contains a mechanical identity / decomposition section before any settings
expectations.evidence: No structured Mechanical Identity section. Output begins with 'The Core Problem' (framing) and jumps directly into a single setting proposal. No extraction of core loops, resource dynamics, or tension structure as separate analysis.

expectations.text: At least 5 distinct setting concepts are presented
expectations.evidence: Only 1 setting presented: 'A Nomadic Convoy in a Dying Desert'. No exploration of alternatives.

expectations.text: Every setting concept includes a Mechanical Mapping section that addresses specific mechanics
expectations.evidence: The single setting has deep mechanic analysis, but it's not structured as per the expected format (no 'Mechanical Mapping' header), and the assertion requires multiple settings each with the section.

expectations.text: Every setting concept includes a Fusion Rating using the ★ scale
expectations.evidence: No fusion ratings used anywhere in the output.

expectations.text: Output includes a ranked recommendation section after the settings
expectations.evidence: No recommendation section — only one setting was generated, so no ranking was possible. Output ends with tonal notes and a summary table.

expectations.text: At least one setting avoids the obvious post-apocalyptic/wasteland/sci-fi framing
expectations.evidence: The only setting ('Nomadic Convoy in a Dying Desert') IS a post-apocalyptic wasteland scenario, which is the most obvious interpretation of the prompt.

expectations.text: At least one setting addresses what crew member permadeath MEANS in the fiction
expectations.evidence: The output has a dedicated section 'Permadeath for Crew Members (Not Run-Ending)' with strong reasoning: 'A convoy survives individuals... People are born on the move. People die on the move. The convoy remembers them but does not stop.' Good depth even without the skill.

expectations.text: At least 3 settings describe audio or music direction, not just visual style
expectations.evidence: No sensory identity sections. The single setting mentions some aesthetic elements but no structured audio/music direction. The output ends with 'exhausted competence' as a tonal note but no sound design direction.

notes: Without the skill, the agent produced one deeply-analyzed setting instead of 5-8 structured concepts. The depth of the single setting is high quality, but the breadth, structure, and format are entirely absent.
